correctness.rationale: For every finite real-symmetric adjacency matrix A, the blow-up A⊗J_m has projectors E_lambda⊗P (lambda≠0) and E0⊗P+I⊗Q (zero), even for singular A. Expanding all Schur squares uses three exact elementary Hadamard identities. The resulting matrix diagonalizes orthogonally into the clone-constant sector with (R+(m−1)I)/m and n clone-difference sectors with (m−2+2(E0)uu)/m (each multiplicity m−1). Positive semidefiniteness of R and E0 gives the sharp lower bound and all ranks; no finite-enumeration inference is used. Exact independent spectral projector replay succeeded on 14 graph/fibre combinations, with 54 further full-matrix numerical comparisons (maximum residual 3e−15). This establishes all quantifiers, normalized mixing and zero-mode boundaries, including disconnected and isolated-base cases.

originality.rationale: The 2022 exact-quantum-walk source establishes the general Schur-square formula; the 2023 blow-up article establishes the blow-up spectral idempotents and strongly cospectral clone criterion. Their respective stated results stop short of an average-mixing spectrum or rank theorem for all blow-ups. The new conclusion diagonalizes the Schur-squared projectors on orthogonal constant-fibre and fibre-difference sectors, proves a universal sharp gap for all m>=3, and identifies exactly the m=2 kernel. It is a short consequence of public spectral ingredients and is therefore subject to a genuine implicit-corollary/terminology overlap risk, but no directly covering statement was identified after reading the principal full texts and targeted searches.
residual_risks: The new theorem has a short proof from two already-published general formulas; an unlocated paper or implicit corollary might have stated the identical spectral gap or rank classification.
Search databases are incomplete and full comparison cannot establish absolute novelty.
Earlier special-case conclusions for two-clone and complete multipartite blow-ups are strictly contained in this all-graph result and are not separately claimed as new.

value.rationale: The object is a natural entire operation (all equal-size independent-fibre blow-ups) in quantum transport. The theorem gives its complete average-mixing eigenspectrum, a sharp base-independent positive-definiteness gap for all clone sizes m≥3 and an exact two-clone kernel in terms of zero-mode support, equivalent to the source literature’s strong-cospectrality obstruction. These conclusions supply a structural classification across arbitrary base graphs rather than a table lookup, isolated example, parameter rename or numerical exercise. Value is a complete natural classification and bridge between time-average mixing and state transfer, not a claim of a new general Schur-square theorem.
